other_conditions: Applicant must be a worker registered with the Goa Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
Worker must have continuous membership with the Board for 3 years
Scheme also applies to female beneficiaries for their own marriage
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹4,000 for the marriage of the worker's children (or for a female beneficiary's own marriage).
documents_required: Self‑attested copies of mandatory documents (if required)
